assets.scope: maze pool, thieves-tunnels (rare), the bandit-fortress zone and the bandit-fortress and thief-hideout vaults (general/npcs/thieve.lua:190, humanoid/human, non-unique, define_as THIEF_SAPPER, rank 2, base BASE_NPC_THIEF, explicit image=npc/humanoid_human_assassin.png); the only definition of this name

references.note: Approved disc, lighting and camera; do not copy its creature.

Native shape (64x64; the leaf reuses the assassin PNG): a crouching black-clad hooded and masked figure with a curved dagger held low. Keep a crouched hooded, masked, low-slung rogue, but this token must NOT be the shipped assassin: render a goggled trapper in dun khaki and olive-brown cloth with a bandolier of brass spring-traps, a trap satchel and a small spiked steel trap in one hand.

Five shipped human thief tokens (bald brawny bandit with two knives and an orange belt, dark-cloaked thief, blue-hooded rogue with a dagger, blue-grey hooded assassin with a white scarf and twin knives, cutpurse in a tan vest): the bandit lord is a BEARDED, long-haired, bare-chested brawny man with arms crossed, crimson baggy trousers, a gold sash and gold armbands, a sheathed curved sabre at the hip, no drawn knives, not bald and not hooded; the rogue sapper is a crouched goggled trapper in DUN KHAKI and olive-brown cloth with a bandolier of brass spring-traps, a satchel of trap parts and a small spiked steel trap held in one hand, not blue-grey and not white-scarfed.

prompt_fields.subject: A rogue sapper seen from a steep overhead three-quarter angle: a compact CROUCHED sneaking rogue facing the lower left, a pulled-up hood and face wrap of PALE SAND and light bone-beige linen with bright cream highlight planes on every upper-left fold, round BRIGHT BRASS-RIMMED GOGGLES with amber lenses on the forehead, a light bone-beige tunic, a diagonal light-grey leather BANDOLIER studded with small polished BRASS SPRING-TRAPS, a big light-grey leather SATCHEL of trap parts on the hip with a few bright steel spikes sticking out, one gloved hand holding up close to the chest a BIG ROUND PALE-STEEL BOMB with a short lit fuse and a small orange spark, the other hand a short bright curved steel dagger held low, light tan-grey gloves and boots; no props on the ground. Crouched, sand-coloured, goggled, bomb-carrying and complete.
prompt_fields.contrast: Human thieves: the ROGUE SAPPER is the CROUCHED GOGGLED TRAPPER in DUN KHAKI AND OLIVE-BROWN cloth with a bandolier of brass spring-traps, a satchel and a steel bear-trap in hand (silhouette: a hunched hooded figure with a bulky satchel and a trap held up; hue: khaki, olive-brown, brass and steel with amber goggles; value: mid-light). The shipped assassin is a blue-grey hooded figure with a white scarf and twin knives, the rogue blue-hooded, the thief dark-cloaked, the bandit a bald brawler: this must not be blue-grey, not white-scarfed, not black and must show the traps.
prompt_fields.composition: One compact complete creature on a single circular tabletop disc, steep overhead three-quarter camera; visible clear neutral base ring on every side. Keep all anatomy and equipment well inside the inner four-fifths of disc radius. Base brightness must visually match reference neutral disc, with no illumination spill or ground effects. Disc plate discipline: measured results show generations of this style reference tend to render the disc DARKER than the reference, never lighter. So do not darken the disc at all: render the neutral disc -- including the whole outer-sixth ring band and the area under the creature -- at reference lightness, a hair lighter, never darker (the style reference's own brightness). No warm cast, glow, bounce-light, gradient or vignette anywhere on the disc. Do not darken the creature to compensate either. Add no warm cast, glow, bounce-light, gradient or vignette to the disc anywhere, including directly under or behind dark-bodied creatures. The ENTIRE creature, every limb, tail, wing, drip, staff and effect included, fits inside a circle of about three quarters of the disc radius around the disc centre, leaving a wide bare charcoal ring of base plate on every side, yet the creature is large and bold inside that circle. Draw the creature COMPACT and chunky: limbs, weapons, tools, cloth and effects are pulled in so the whole silhouette forms one rounded mass inside the inner three quarters of the disc; no tip, blade, hat brim, tentacle end, antenna or tail reaches the outer sixth ring band or crosses the disc rim. Value discipline (measured lesson from earlier tokens, including a rejected dark war dog and drem master): the creature's large masses are MID-LIGHT to LIGHT in value, clearly LIGHTER than the charcoal disc, with broad pale highlight planes on every upper-left surface and a thin bright LIGHT RIM along the outline, so the silhouette reads as a bright shape on the dark disc at very small size. Nothing near-black except tiny eye slits and thin seams; no black cloth, black leather, black armour, black chitin or black fur anywhere. DARK-SUBJECT DISCIPLINE (the native art of this creature is almost black; earlier near-black tokens were rejected at 48px): render it in MID-LIGHT slate and ash values, never black, at least as light as the copper-grey bevel of the disc and clearly lighter than the charcoal plate, with a thin bright pale RIM LIGHT along the whole upper-left outline and bright accent patches (named in the brief) so that the silhouette reads as a light shape on the dark disc at 48 pixels. LIGHT-VALUE REFINEMENT (the previous version was rejected at 48 pixels: dark brown leather, brown cloth and brown boots merged into one muddy brown blob on the brown floors): draw the sapper in PALE SAND and LIGHT BONE-BEIGE linen (hood, face wrap and tunic) with LIGHT DOVE-GREY and pale tan-grey leather (straps, gloves, boots, satchel), a BRIGHT pale RIM LIGHT along the whole outline, BRIGHT POLISHED BRASS goggle rims with bright amber lenses, and a clearly visible BIG round pale-steel BOMB with a short lit fuse and a spark (held in one hand, close to the chest) plus a large light-grey leather SATCHEL bristling with a few bright steel spikes on the hip. The figure is compact and BIG: it fills the inner three quarters of the disc (about 0.7 of the disc radius across, centred, everything tucked inside), NOT thin. No brown mass, no dark brown, no black, no charcoal anywhere, only tiny eye shadows and thin seams; NO cast shadow, contact shadow or dark halo on the plate; render the whole disc, outer ring and plate under the figure at reference lightness, a hair lighter, never darker, evenly all round.
prompt_fields.palette: Dun khaki and olive-brown cloth in a mid-light value with pale highlight planes and a bright rim light, polished brass and steel trap parts, amber goggle lenses; nothing darker than deep olive-brown except thin seams and the eye shadow; NO black cloth or black leather anywhere; the disc stays neutral charcoal at reference lightness. Dry neutral charcoal disc with restrained copper-grey bevel, kept a visibly lighter value than the creature's darkest parts so the two never merge.

assets.gate_reason: Exact source identity re-verified directly against game/modules/tome source (name=rogue sapper, define_as=THIEF_SAPPER, type=humanoid/subtype=human, unique=False, native_tall=False); details and hashes in evidence/monster-batch-z-20260930/source-contracts.json. base BASE_NPC_THIEF (humanoid/human, no image=, no shader); explicit image= on the leaf (no nice_tile, add_mos, moddable_tile, shader, anim or add_displays on the leaf or base); generic actor.image==entry.image single path; native sprite 64x64; resolvers.racial() only adds human levelup talents (Higher Heal, Born into Magic, Highborn's Bloom: passives, no display write) and the base calls resolvers.sustains_at_birth() (Stealth and Total Thuggery are sustains: temporary values only); resolvers.equip daggers and light armour (equipment only, no moddable_tile); the leaf binds define_as THIEF_SAPPER and calls resolvers.sustains_at_birth() (Stealth is the only sustain: temporary values only); Trap Mastery, Trap Priming, Dual Strike and Disarm are activated, the rest passive; the explicit image is the assassin's PNG (humanoid_human_assassin.png), which the assassin catalog entry also names, but the two are told apart by name and define_as (THIEF_ASSASSIN vs THIEF_SAPPER). Exact catalog entry only, never a whole-subtype mapping.

refinement.design_change_reason: The first rogue sapper (khaki and olive-brown cloth, brown leather; masked luminance 69.2) passed the numeric style gate but the coordinator's 48px floor review found it a muddy brown blob on most floors. This refinement changes the value design, not just the roll: pale sand and bone-beige linen instead of dun khaki and olive-brown, light dove-grey leather instead of brown, bright brass goggles, a bright rim light, a large clearly visible pale-steel bomb with a lit fuse and a light-grey satchel, and a larger compact figure so the body mass is light; it stays a goggled trapper and not the assassin's slate-blue hooded lunger.
